# Shopware Storefront — Page and Pagelet classes

Every Storefront page is a struct filled by a loader. The loader builds the generic page first (header, footer, meta), adds its own data, then dispatches its loaded event.

**33 page domains, 29 page structs, 8 pagelet domains.**

## Contents

- [How to extend a page](#how-to-extend-a-page)
- [Page domains](#page-domains)
- [Pagelet domains](#pagelet-domains)
- [What a Page always carries](#what-a-page-always-carries)

## How to extend a page

Subscribe to the domain's `*PageLoadedEvent` and attach your data as an extension:

```php
public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
{
    return [ProductPageLoadedEvent::class => 'onProductPageLoaded'];
}

public function onProductPageLoaded(ProductPageLoadedEvent $event): void
{
    $event->getPage()->addExtension('myData', new ArrayStruct([...]));
}
```

In Twig the extension is reachable as `page.extensions.myData`. Decorating the PageLoader also works and is the choice when the data must exist before other subscribers run; overriding the controller is almost never right.

## What a Page always carries

`GenericPageLoader` fills these before any domain loader runs, so they are available in every template that receives a `page`:

- **`page.header`** — navigation tree, active language and currency, the cart widget.
- **`page.footer`** — footer columns and service menu.
- **`page.metaInformation`** — title, description, canonical URL, robots directives.
- **`page.salesChannelContext`** — customer, currency, tax state, payment and shipping method.
- **`page.extensions`** — anything a subscriber attached via `addExtension()`.
